notes: passes=true means verified this session: unit tests (npm test, 49/49) and/or a scripted run of the real UI in Chrome against http://127.0.0.1:4173 (48 checks, 0 failures). Story IDs are the baseline backlog IDs from Lab 3; no Sprint 0 R-numbers were available, so none are cited.

features.name: Employer submits an opportunity (IPP-01 / EMP-01)
features.description: Employer HR form requires organization, title, description and location; whitespace-only values are rejected; a valid submission gets a unique ID (OPP-003, …) and starts as Pending Review.
verification_steps: Employer HR > Fill sample data > Submit for review: OPP-003 appears as Pending Review
Leave organization as spaces and submit: inline errors, nothing created, typed values kept
features.notes: Store tests + UI run (valid and error cases).

features.name: Simulated HR authorization blocks submission (IPP-02 / EMP-02)
features.description: Unticking 'Simulate an authorized HR representative' disables submission and states that real authorization is deferred.
verification_steps: Untick the checkbox: submit disabled and blocked message visible
Re-tick: submit enabled
features.notes: Simulated control only; real authorization is deferred (IPP-17).

features.name: Employer sees approval status (IPP-03 / EMP-03)
features.description: Opportunity status list reads the shared record, so administrator approval is reflected on the same ID.
verification_steps: After admin approves OPP-003, Employer HR list shows OPP-003 as Approved

features.name: Administrator review queue (IPP-04 / ADM-01)
features.description: Lists Pending Review opportunities with organization, title, description, location and ID; shows an empty-state message when none.
verification_steps: Queue shows OPP-003 after submission
After approval the queue shows 'The review queue is empty'

features.name: Administrator approves an opportunity (IPP-05 / ADM-02, ADM-03)
features.description: Approve changes the same record to Approved, removes it from the queue, lists it under Approved opportunities and makes it visible to students.
verification_steps: Approve OPP-003; Student view now lists 3 approved opportunities

features.name: Student browse and search (IPP-06 / STU-01)
features.description: Only Approved opportunities are shown, with organization, title, description, location, work mode and duration; search matches title or organization; clear no-results message.
verification_steps: Before approval, 'harbor' finds nothing and total stays 2
Search 'harbor' after approval finds OPP-003
Search 'zzzz' shows the no-match message

features.name: Student applies with confirmation (IPP-07 / STU-02)
features.description: Confirmation dialog names opportunity and applicant and says it does not approve a placement; cancel creates nothing; confirm creates APP-001 (Submitted, with submitted_at) plus a faculty review record.
verification_steps: Apply > Cancel: applications stay 0
Apply > Submit application: APP-001 created, status Submitted
Escape closes the dialog without applying

features.name: Duplicate application prevention (IPP-08 / STU-02)
features.description: After applying, the card shows 'Application submitted' and offers no Apply button; the store also rejects a second application for the same student and opportunity.
verification_steps: After applying, no Apply button for that opportunity
Store test: second submitApplication returns duplicate

features.name: My applications (IPP-09 / STU-03)
features.description: Lists application ID, linked opportunity, application status and a separate 'Not placed' placement status; the application count updates.
verification_steps: My applications tab shows APP-001 / OPP-003 / Submitted / Not placed; tab count reads (1)

features.name: Student demo profile (IPP-10 / STU-04)
features.description: Nonblank display name can be saved; student ID and seeded eligibility shown; eligibility verification identified as deferred.
verification_steps: Save a blank name: error; save 'Alex R. Lee': heading and Faculty view update

features.name: Faculty read-only application view (IPP-11 / FAC-01, FAC-03)
features.description: Shows student name, organization, title, application/student/opportunity/review IDs and review status; no action controls; informative empty state.
verification_steps: Faculty view shows APP-001, STU-001, OPP-003, REV-001
No buttons, inputs or selects inside the view content

features.name: Application vs placement status (IPP-12 / FAC-02)
features.description: Application status Submitted and placement status Not placed are displayed separately, with a statement that viewing an application does not approve a placement.
verification_steps: Faculty and Student views show both statuses and the disclaimer

features.name: Role switching with visible disclosure (IPP-13)
features.description: Four role views reachable from the sidebar (hash routes) plus an Overview; persistent banner states that role switching and HR authorization are simulated; a 'Simulated' tag marks the persona in the top bar.
verification_steps: Visit each role; banner present on all
features.notes: Opens on the Overview (DEFAULT_ROUTE in src/app.js); set it to 'student' to open on the Student view as in the Lab 3 appendix reference.

features.name: Records persist across role changes and reloads (IPP-14)
features.description: Records are stored in browser localStorage; the banner explains they are browser-local and not shared across users or devices. Falls back to in-memory with a warning if storage is blocked.
verification_steps: Create a full journey, reload the page: Faculty view still shows APP-001
features.notes: Blocked-storage fallback covered by a store test, not exercised in a real private window.

features.name: Reset demo data with confirmation (IPP-15)
features.description: Reset opens a confirmation dialog (Cancel is the default); confirming restores the two sample opportunities and the sample student and clears submissions and applications; IDs restart.
verification_steps: Reset > Cancel keeps data
Reset > confirm restores 2 opportunities, 0 applications

features.name: Integrated four-role acceptance flow (IPP-16)
features.description: One new record travels Employer > Admin > Student > Faculty with consistent IDs while placement stays Not placed.
verification_steps: Follow the demo script in PROJECT_DESCRIPTION.md
features.notes: Store-level test plus a scripted run of the real UI in Chrome (32 checks, 0 failures).

features.name: Responsive layout, keyboard and screen-reader basics
features.description: Single-column layout on narrow screens with a fixed bottom tab bar and no horizontal overflow; labeled controls; aria-live announcements; arrow-key tab navigation; focus management after dialogs and actions; reduced-motion support.
verification_steps: Load at 390px width: no horizontal overflow in any of 7 route states, 5-item bottom tab bar
Arrow keys move between student tabs
features.notes: Layout and keyboard verified in Chrome (390px iframe). Not verified: real phone, other browsers, an actual screen reader, a formal contrast audit.

features.name: Overview page with live metrics
features.description: Landing page with a hero, four live stat tiles (pending, approved, applications, placement status), clickable step cards per role, the journey tracker, recent activity and a working/simulated/deferred summary.
verification_steps: Open the app: it lands on the Overview
Complete the journey in other roles and return: stats read 0 / 3 / 1 and the journey shows 4 completed steps
features.notes: Scripted UI run (Chrome) and store tests.

features.name: Live journey tracker
features.description: Shows how the most recent submitted record moves through Employer HR, Administrator, Student and Faculty (Done / Next step / Waiting), links each step to its role, and always shows placement status separately as Not placed.
verification_steps: Submit an opportunity: step 1 done, step 2 is the next step
Approve then apply: all four steps done and a Complete chip appears
features.notes: getJourney() covered by store tests; rendering covered by the scripted UI run.

features.name: Recent activity feed
features.description: Records each hand-off (submitted, approved, applied, display name changed, reset) with the acting role and a relative time that refreshes; new entries are highlighted once; capped at 60 entries; survives reloads.
verification_steps: Perform the journey: the feed lists the events newest first
Reload: the feed is still there
features.notes: Failed actions and unchanged names are not logged (store tests).

features.name: Employer live listing preview
features.description: As the employer types, a preview card shows how students will see the listing, with placeholders for empty fields and a description character counter.
verification_steps: Type an organization, title and description: the preview and counter update immediately
features.notes: Layout switches by main-column width (container query): preview above the form when narrow, beside it when wide. The wide layout was not exercised on a wide screen in this session.

features.name: Student filters and sorting
features.description: Work-mode filter (All / On-site / Hybrid / Remote), sort (Newest first / Title A-Z) alongside search, a result count, and a Clear filters action in the no-results state.
verification_steps: Filter Hybrid: only Product Design Intern
Filter Remote: empty state with Clear filters; clearing restores all
